verdict.first_step_1: Feed a single jar of starter at a 1:2:2 ratio, mark the level with a rubber band, keep it warm, and watch whether it doubles within 4 to 8 hours.
verdict.first_step_2: Feed two separate jars side-by-side (one with the new flour, one with the old flour or whole wheat/rye), mark both levels, and check hourly to compare peak times.
verdict.reason: Reply 1 uses a practical single-jar test that accounts for multi-cycle adaptation, whereas Reply 2 demands an impractical hourly two-jar test with an improper grain control that risks a false diagnosis.
